parsed_results.text: Run the job once, not more.
We retried failed notifications, not failed payments.
We found no improvement in the smaller sample, unlike Lee et al. [4].
The deployment finally worked. Mercifully, my celebratory dance went undocumented.
The cache may reduce latency by about 10% for repeated requests, but cold starts are untested.
The tapestry depicts a coastal landscape.
Please send the invoice by Friday.
The team launched the dashboard on Tuesday.
The prototype aims to detect duplicate invoices. We have not tested its accuracy. It could help the finance team.
The vector represents velocity. The robust regression estimates the slope while limiting the influence of outliers.
The migration is complete, finally. "Ready to launch," the manager said. We still need to check the backups.

On Tuesday, I helped deploy the cache to two servers. In our 30-minute test, median latency for repeated requests fell from 80 ms to 60 ms. We have not tested cold starts or the other eight servers. The cache could reduce support tickets. The dashboard still shows yesterday's data.
